sentences.text:
Date : 15.07. 2024 Heard Mr. A. Rahman, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. B. Sarma,
learned Addl. Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 438 Cr. P.C. seeking anticipatory bail by the petitioner namely Hobi Sk @ Habibar Rahman in connection with Dhubri P.S. Case No. 156/2024 under Sections 120B/ 294/ 420/ 406/ 506/ 34 IPC.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is the owner and possessor of the land which was acquisitioned by the Government.
He further submits that the petitioner has received the compensation amount, awarded by the Government.
He further submitted that the adjacent land was belonged to the informant and he also received the compensation amount and his land was acquisitioned in 2016.

The present petitioner is Page No.#
2/2 harassing by the complainant by alleging false and concocted allegations.
However, he will cooperate with the investigation, if the privilege of pre- arrest bail is granted to him.

sentences.text: In this context, Mr. Sarma, the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor has submitted that as per the allegation, the present petitioner in connivance with others received the awarded compensation by impersonating the informant and accordingly he insisted to call for the case diary.
Accordingly, call for the case diary, fixing 05.08.2024.

Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the petitioner and the submission of the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case to grant the interim pre-arrest bail to the petitioner till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly it is provided that till next date, in the event of arrest of the petitioner above named in connection with the aforementioned case, he shall be released on interim pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the following conditions that:-
1. the petitioner shall appear before the I.O. within 7 days from today from today.
List the matter 05.08.2024 for production of case diary.
